x.en:
Usage Monitor 42 lands in your terminal: every quota in one command, JSON for scripts, a status line for Claude Code and tmux, a headless service, and an interactive mode with six tabs, even over SSH. Open source (MIT).
https://github.com/edilsonvilarinho/usage-monitor/releases/tag/v42.0.0

instagram.pt:
Usage Monitor 42: agora também no seu terminal.

O que chegou:
• usage-monitor status — todas as cotas e o ritmo de cada uma
• JSON, check e wait para scripts
• Linha de status para o Claude Code e o tmux, e status --watch
• Serviço para servidor sem tela (systemd no Linux)
• Configuração inicial, chaves, contas, Telegram e time pelo terminal
• Modo interativo com seis abas, até por SSH
• Sessões divididas por modelo
• Cada janela da cota na diagonal de ritmo
• No time, a etapa exata em que a conexão parou
• E mais: comando no PATH do Windows, data de reinício na HUD, escala do sistema

Windows, Linux e macOS. Open source (MIT). Link na bio.

#ClaudeCode #Codex #OpenSource #DevTools #Terminal
instagram.en:
Usage Monitor 42: now in your terminal, too.

What's new:
• usage-monitor status — every quota and its pace
• JSON, check and wait for scripts
• A status line for Claude Code and tmux, plus status --watch
• A service for headless servers (systemd on Linux)
• Setup, API keys, accounts, Telegram and team from the terminal
• An interactive mode with six tabs, even over SSH
• Sessions split by model
• Each quota window on the pace diagonal
• Team: the exact step where the connection stopped
• Plus: the command on your Windows PATH, reset dates on the HUD, system scale

Windows, Linux and macOS. Open source (MIT). Link in bio.
